text: Hi, I received my single status certificate (Ledigkeitsbescheinigung) with Apostille from Austria and it was issued with a translation guide (Übersetzungshilfe) in English. Does the document still need to be translated and notarised given the certificate itself is in German or is it enough to provide the translation guide? The guide is also signed and stamped by the Standesamt and includes my specific information. If anyone has any experience it would be super helpful! Thanks so much.
